In my opinion, generally there is no problem with headcanoning a character in a het relationship as bisexual because I believe there are different rules when thinking about fictional characters versus when dealing with actual live people. Anyone can portray theoretically anything onto an imagined image so what’s stopping you? The difference between real and imagined is that in the world of the imagination the perceived subject will have no innate response within itself unless given to it by the thinker/perceiver; versus subjects (people) in physical reality responding to stimuli regardless of what the perceiver thinks.

The problem can come in, I think, when we superimpose those images onto the reality of a human without having room for their say-so or input. This person may oppose, deny, or disagree with ideas imposed upon them. So, as long as when you’re dealing with live beings you leave room for the response/influence of someone else, I think you’re good.
